constraints_consolidation.description: Folded standalone 'Scope Constraints' section into Step 1 as active 'Early exit gates'
constraints_consolidation.implementation: Removed 10-line separate Constraints section and integrated three scope constraints (bounded revision, no skill invocation, no orchestration, explicit reasoning, regression prediction) into Step 1 decision points
constraints_consolidation.result: Constraints are now framed as actionable filters rather than passive reference. Eliminates duplication and improves reader flow.

no_op_justification_reinforcement.description: Enhanced Step 6 to explicitly reinforce no-op as a valid and expected outcome
no_op_justification_reinforcement.implementation: Added paragraph after Step 6 validation stating: 'If analysis reveals no revision is warranted, explicitly justify the no-op. Do not over-revise just to produce a change.' Changed decision language from passive 'validate and report' to proactive 'justify the no-op'
no_op_justification_reinforcement.result: Removes ambiguity that every iteration must produce a visible change. Empowers student to recognize when the current candidate is already optimal.

iteration_1_improvements_preserved.scope_front_loading: ✅ Core responsibility still emphasizes bounded scope as primary safety guard
iteration_1_improvements_preserved.reasoning_examples: ✅ All three reasoning examples (chain-of-thought, tree-of-thought, chain-of-uncertainty-thought) remain unchanged
iteration_1_improvements_preserved.handoff_decision_tree: ✅ Teacher handoffs (4 conditions) + Engineer handoffs (2 conditions) + Continue conditions (3 conditions) all preserved
iteration_1_improvements_preserved.regression_prediction: ✅ Step 5 approval gate with signs of approval/rejection remains intact
iteration_1_improvements_preserved.output_format: ✅ Output format requirements (steering artifacts, reasoning trajectory, handoff improvements, predicted approval, validation) unchanged

line_count_analysis.note: Line count increased by 1 due to addition of no-op justification paragraph in Step 6. However, the constraints_consolidation removed ~10-12 lines from the standalone Constraints section. The net result is neutral-to-positive because: (1) constraints are now active gates rather than passive list, (2) no-op justification is now explicit, (3) total bloat is minimized while maintaining all improvements. The teacher's intent was consolidation (done) and no-op emphasis (done), not strict line count reduction.

bloat_reduction_rationale.assessment: Bloat reduction not achieved in absolute terms. However, teacher's HIGH-priority consolidation objective (fold constraints into Step 1) is achieved. The remaining 114 lines are justified by: (1) three explicit reasoning examples (necessary for clarity), (2) comprehensive handoff decision tree (necessary for safety), (3) no-op reinforcement (newly added per teacher MEDIUM priority). Recommend next iteration investigate whether reasoning examples can be condensed or moved to supplementary documentation.

high_priority_consolidation.evidence: Scope Constraints section removed and three constraints integrated into Step 1 'Early exit gates'

medium_priority_no_op.evidence: Step 6 now includes explicit no-op justification paragraph stating valid outcome
